comment: Large vero layout 33 x 26, populated board left and cuts view right. Six LDRs lit by three on-board red LEDs, TL074 and two TL072, a 78L09, four transistors labelled in the margins and three 100K trimmers; buffered effect with non-standard bypass wiring. The off-board Rate LED has no type given and is left out.
uncertain: Transistor types are printed in the board margin, not on the parts: 3904 beside the upper-left and lower-right transistors, 5089 under the two lower-left ones; the pairing is by position
10K count (19) on a dense board: could be off by one
rows: D1-3: Rectangular Red LEDs, on the board facing the LDRs
